items.title: Luxury sales plunge in China as tax push hits wealthy shoppers
items.summary: Wire report finds Gucci (Kering) posted a double-digit sales drop in China in July 2026 alongside peers, as sales at the 25 biggest luxury labels there fell over 10 percent -- worse than June -- amid a capital-outflow and offshore-asset tax crackdown; analysts cite a fading wealth effect among VIP clients as the MSCI China index is down 8.9 percent year to date, with the slump also hitting Macau casino revenue.

items.title: Kering, balzo in borsa dopo segnali di ripresa Gucci in trim2
items.summary: Italian financial outlet reports Kering shares jumped as much as 14-17 percent in a single Paris session after Gucci's Q2 revenue decline narrowed to about 3 percent, beating the roughly 5 percent drop analysts had forecast, driven by strong US demand for new bag styles; HSBC upgraded the stock from Hold to Buy, raising its target price from EUR290 to EUR340.

items.title: Gucci seemingly on cusp of turnaround
items.summary: Trade press notes that despite a still-negative H1 2026 (revenue EUR2.757bn, -9 percent reported), Gucci appears to be turning a corner under CEO Francesca Bellettini and Kering CEO Luca de Meo's ReconKering plan; cites the newly announced Gucci Racing Alpine Formula 1 title partnership from 2027 as a visibility play ahead of the L'Oreal beauty-license handover.

items.title: Gucci.com customer reviews thread on craftsmanship and repairs
items.summary: Ongoing consumer review stream shows recent complaints about stitching failing on straps, hardware tarnishing after light use, and lengthy or costly repair processes (one case citing over 5 months for a return, another a second EUR200+ repair charge for the same strap failure); reviewers describe materials as below expectation for the price point.

items.title: Gucci quality concerns thread (continued activity)
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread continues to draw new posts into late August, with members comparing recent Demna-era pieces unfavorably to older archive construction and debating whether repeated reliance on legacy Horsebit/Web codes across new bags (Paparazzo, Borsetto) signals design fatigue rather than renewal.

items.title: The Gucci Borsetto is quietly becoming the it-bag
items.summary: Handbag-collector outlet reports growing community enthusiasm for the Borsetto -- a Boston-shaped bag built on Horsebit hardware and Web-stripe house codes -- describing it as gaining traction among core Gucci followers as a wearable, archive-referencing alternative to the more polarizing runway pieces.

items.title: Generation Gucci city-fashion series continues on TikTok
items.summary: Gucci's official TikTok channel continues posting Generation Gucci/#CityFashion content built around urban styling; reaction and duet videos from fashion commentators keep circulating, mixing genuine style engagement with recurring skepticism about whether the campaign concept translates into product interest versus pure content churn.

items.title: Primavera campaign post continues to draw comment volume
items.summary: Official Gucci Instagram Primavera campaign post remains among the brand's most-commented recent posts; treated as activation coverage per sentiment-rubric discount, but comment volume (mix of celebrity-fan praise and recurring AI-imagery skepticism carried over from the pre-show controversy) is a genuine buzz signal.
